scope: Audit existing backend; no new backend, production optimization or policy change retained.

diagnostic.counterScope: One fresh process / one CombatSearchCoordinator.Solve; disabled during root setup, enabled at Solve entry, thread-local counters aggregated at scope disposal after workers finish. Only one report observed.

counterDefinitions.fork_calls: Successful stable-boundary Simulator.Fork entries, before graph copying.
counterDefinitions.fork_power_calls: ForkPower invocations before TryRemap; may include mapping hits; not an exact deep-clone count.
counterDefinitions.card_model_clones: CloneCardStateForSimulation invocations only; excludes other native/generation clone entry points.
counterDefinitions.affliction_card_visits: One increment inside the Hex/Tangled/Ringing full-card loop.
counterDefinitions.power_affliction_card_visits: One increment inside NormalizePowerAfflictions full-card loop.
counterDefinitions.sword_sage_card_visits: One increment inside NormalizeSwordSageReplays full-card loop, before type/clone filtering.
counterDefinitions.base_listener_builds: GetBaseHookListeners cache misses entering list construction.
counterDefinitions.effective_listener_builds: GetEffectiveHookListeners cache misses, including paths returning baseListeners.
counterDefinitions.mirror_layout_builds: Filter requires a new type layout because null or ordered types mismatch.
counterDefinitions.mirror_layout_entries: Sum of source.Count at each new type-layout construction.
counterDefinitions.pending_choice_snapshots: Snapshot invocations with PendingChoice in the incoming boundary argument, before Snapshot can adjust it.
counterDefinitions.filtered_hook_slots_examined: Mask tests in the MirroredHookListenerSnapshot enumerator only; excludes fallback/unfiltered/native enumeration.
counterDefinitions.filtered_hook_receivers_yielded: Successful yields from that same filtered mask loop; does not assert handler completion.
counterDefinitions.rng_set_forks: CombatPredictionRngSet.Fork invocations; production Fork clones nine streams.
counterDefinitions.base_listener_invalidations: InvalidateBaseHookListeners calls, including already invalid caches.
counterDefinitions.effective_listener_invalidations: InvalidateHookListeners calls, including nested calls from base invalidation and already invalid caches.

existingTraceReanalysis.description: Offline reanalysis of previous 25-second EventPipe trace. GCAllocationTick estimates with CombatBeamSolver in stack; Snapshot > Fork > Replay > Retention > Other precedence gives non-overlapping categories. Not CPU/wall percentages or exact bytes.
